name: Milfred Lee Unruh
description: A working farm in Aliceville, AL, Milfred Lee Unruh grows Tomatoes, Green beans, and Peas. The farm is busiest in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Oct in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
